title: Research: realize the corrected P104 dual in complementary native frames
body:
## Summary

Add `research/p104-complementary-dual/`, a complementary native-frame realization of the complete corrected P104 logical inverse-transpose.

```text
PR2497 descending persistent frame paths
  physical-label orthogonal complementation
358 monotone persistent paths, unchanged local rank mass 3126
```

Exact native checks cover 909 directed transport types, 1654 occurrences and 208 monomial intrinsic endpoint adapters, including global phase. The full 4982-event scalar word and eight exact private zero erasures are retained. This closes the finite persistent-frame/native-price part of the predecessor's complementary-frame handoff.

The physical operator is the stated logical inverse-transpose between new complementary charts. It is not physical F^-T, not a free conversion of the predecessor's physical arrays, and not a complete supplier.

Card `p104-side-correction`, priority revision 4, with a documented pivot from the already-covered direct-ADD question to this finite frame interface. Scientific base is `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`.

Credit ywz65 / #2497 at `7f2cf129d42030d3eb3975b7d1b07392c6d32a1b` for the complete word and zero-restoring collectors, #2458 at `3170afd2fc13a990bfe28f5ab6421bcda4ffd0f6` for native forward binding, Ross Richardson / #2445 for two-target correction, and the retained compiler/interpreter/P104 lineage. The complete source word is retained byte-for-byte and all source-specific notices remain intact.

[Tested artifact](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/tree/8af7c324714866afa199e4b7bf80a8f82e56d6f3/research/p104-complementary-dual)

## Evidence

- **Before:** the pinned backward word has descending persistent paths and explicitly leaves a complementary monotone realization open.
  **After:** all 358 persistent paths are monotone in the physical-label complements. Exact phase/rank checks, all 128164 arbitrary-input boundary coefficients and eight private erasures pass at the unchanged profile.
- The registered replay passes six semantic controls and eight tests. A separate dense-dyadic/nullspace implementation covers all 7352 literal frame occurrences. Complete decompressed recipe regeneration, equivalent bases, source-before-import rejection, required evidence, exclusive output and optimized Git-free read-only replay are checked.

```sh
python3.12 -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py \
  --package research/p104-complementary-dual
```

Checked with CPython 3.12.15 on Linux x86_64 / WSL2. The private rank8-to-rank1-to-rank8 paths are not monotone. Physical private storage, scalar/address routing, rounded precision/erasure, global hosting/idle/residual costs, remaining 102 corrections and all-size/caller admission remain open. No full selected cold replay or new kappa is claimed.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** research

Only this opt-in package is added. Selected records and frozen predecessors are unchanged. The logical-versus-physical operator distinction and private-storage limits must remain explicit when using the result.
